title: Counting words
description:
Write the core of a word-frequency tool:

```python
def word_counts(text): ...          # dict of word -> count; words are lower-cased, with .,!?;:"' removed from their ends
def top_words(counts, n): ...       # the n most common (word, count) pairs: highest count first, ties in alphabetical order
def shared_letters(a, b): ...       # sorted list of the letters (a-z, ignoring case) that appear in both words
```

Words are separated by whitespace; a "word" that is empty after removing punctuation is ignored.
hints: Sorting with the key `(-count, word)` puts the highest counts first and breaks ties alphabetically, in one sort.
